subject: Make vl512/vl512w kernels zvfh-free
description: RTL target ax45mpv_premium has no zfh/zvfh (ELEN=32). Replace vlse16_v_f16m1 + vfwcvt scale path with integer expand (vzext + shift + exponent rebias + FTZ merge + reinterpret to f32) behind #if __riscv_zvfh. Switch lab guards to __riscv_v_intrinsic. Add nozvfh build target + QEMU verify with QEMU_CPU without zfh/zvfh.
